events.text: Johan Gabriel Oxenstierna graduated with an administrative degree (kansliexamen).

events.text: Oxenstierna was appointed acting Commission Secretary in Vienna.

events.quote: He was appointed acting Commission Secretary in Vienna in 1770

events.text: Oxenstierna was made the regular Commission Secretary in Vienna.
events.subject: self
events.quote: made the regular Commission Secretary in that city in 1772

events.text: Oxenstierna was recalled to Stockholm by the king and made a Chamberlain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1774 he was recalled to Stockholm by the king and made a Chamberlain

events.text: Oxenstierna was sent on diplomatic missions to several German states.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he was sent on diplomatic missions to

events.text: Oxenstierna was made a senior Chamberlain.

events.quote: He was made a senior Chamberlain in 1783

events.text: Oxenstierna was made a Member of the College of the Chancellery.
events.subject: self
events.quote: a Member of the College of the Chancellery in 1785

events.text: The king made Oxenstierna a member of the Privy Council of Sweden and President of the College of the Chancellery.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1786 , the king made him a member of the Privy Council of Sweden and President of the College of the Chancellery

events.text: The Privy Council was dissolved and the office of College of the Chancellery abolished.
events.subject: self
events.quote: When the Privy Council was dissolved and the office of College of the Chancellery abolished in 1789

events.text: Oxenstierna was made Head Steward for the queen.

events.quote: he was made Head Steward for the queen

events.subject: self
events.quote: shortly before which Oxenstierna was made a Riksmarskalk

events.text: Oxenstierna left all public offices after the king's death.

events.quote: He made a short comeback as a cabinet member in 1798

events.text: Oxenstierna's comeback as a cabinet member continued.

events.text: Oxenstierna accepted being chairman of a committee during the Parliament.

events.quote: accepted being chairman of a committee during the Parliament of 1809
